Star-formation birth phase — proto-stellar disk glowing amber around a newborn ignition point, bipolar jets punching outward through collapsing molecular cloud, millennia in the making.
Supernova death phase — the detonation wave frozen at the instant of outward rupture, stellar interior splashing into space in a single catastrophic instant.
Galaxy-merger collision phase — two spiral systems mid-embrace, tidal arms stretched into luminous orange bridges across billions of years of gravitational inevitability.
Quiet-majesty stable-spiral phase — grand-design arms wound in perfect logarithmic symmetry, dust lanes crisp, the galaxy simply existing across eternal timescales.
Supernova-remnant aftermath phase — an expanding ionized shell centuries post-detonation, the dead core glowing faint blue at center, filaments still racing outward.
First-light discovery phase — a survey telescope's inaugural frame revealing a never-catalogued nebula, the image raw and unprocessed, detection still in progress.
Planet-transit phase — a dark circular silhouette crossing the stellar disk, the star's limb-darkening gradient interrupted by one world's silent millennia-long orbital passage.
Quasar-awakening phase — a previously dormant galactic nucleus blazing back to life, relativistic jets re-emerging, the host galaxy caught off-guard in an eternal-seeming instant.
Light-echo witnessing phase — ancient supernova light scattering off surrounding dust clouds centuries after the original explosion, the past arriving now as photons.
Proto-galaxy formation phase — dark-matter halo threading luminous filaments of primordial gas, the first stellar populations igniting within cold collapsing structure, billions of years initiating.
Planetary-nebula death phase — a dying sun's outer atmosphere blown into concentric glowing rings, the exposed white dwarf at center marking an eternal-seeming quiet conclusion.
Neutron-star inspiral collision phase — two compact remnants spiraling inward in a millisecond death-dance, gravitational waves invisible but the kilonova flash caught at the instant of merger.
Black-hole-feeding awakening phase — an accretion disk forming around a reactivated singularity, infalling material heating to blue-white incandescence as the eternal engine restarts.
Tidal-disruption disruption phase — a star being stretched into a luminous stream around a massive black hole, the spaghettification arc glowing across a single catastrophic instant.
Calm-globular-cluster quiet-majesty phase — hundreds of thousands of ancient stars densely packed, gravitationally bound for billions of years, orbiting in slow eternal procession.
Comet-impact collision phase — a volatile-rich body striking a planetary surface, the impact plume frozen mid-eruption, the crater forming in a geological instant.
Binary-orbital procession phase — two stars locked in millennia-long mutual orbit, tidal bulges visible, mass-transfer stream arcing luminously between the co-rotating pair.
Tidal-stream disruption phase — a satellite galaxy being pulled apart along its orbital path, a stellar ribbon stretching across the frame over billions of years of erosion.
Molecular-cloud-collapse birth phase — a cold dark nebula fragmenting under its own gravity, no stars yet visible, only infrared-warm dense knots hinting at ignition coming.
Solar-eclipse alignment phase — a moon's shadow cone sweeping a planet's surface, the corona suddenly exposed in that syzygy's eternal-seeming momentary totality.
White-dwarf cooling aftermath phase — the stellar remnant fading from blue-white toward invisible red, the surrounding planetary nebula dispersing over tens of thousands of years.
Unexpected-transient discovery phase — a brief unexplained flash appearing in a survey frame with no prior detection, the source unknown, the moment of pure discovery captured.
Jet-boring disruption phase — a relativistic jet punching through the interstellar medium of its host galaxy, shock-heated lobes expanding outward across millions of years.

Primordial-nucleosynthesis formation phase — the first three minutes of the universe, hydrogen and helium forging from a cooling quark-gluon plasma, the visual tone eternally white and undifferentiated.
Recurring-nova outburst awakening phase — a white dwarf erupting for the known fifth time, the shell of earlier outbursts visible as nested glowing rings surrounding this new instant.
